ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Arab Republic of Egypt Law No. 80 of 2016 on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Terrorist Financing, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2020 and Law No. 21 of 2021; Executive Regulations issued by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Oversight Unit (AMLCU); beneficial ownership reporting obligations under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, administered through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI).

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU CFSP sanctions, UK HMT sanctions, the Egyptian Terrorism Entities List, and AMLCU domestic screening lists. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence, including written source-of-funds declarations, senior-management approval, increased ongoing monitoring, and additional documentary support for all wire and payment activity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Company Registration and Name Reservation System, operated by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (https://www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed company name must be rendered in Arabic script as the primary legal name; a Latin-alphabet transliteration is accepted for commercial/banking purposes. The name must not duplicate an existing registered name and must not be misleading about the business activity, legal form, or public/state affiliation. The LLC name must contain the Arabic equivalent of 'Limited Liability Company' or its accepted abbreviation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with GAFI's Legal Affairs Department within 30 days from the rejection notice, supplying authorities confirming the requested name does not conflict with protected marks or public interests. If the administrative appeal is denied, an appeal may be filed before the Administrative Court through the State Council within 60 days of the denial. A new name reservation request may alternatively be submitted immediately without prejudice to the appeal rights where the rejection basis is purely duplicative.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not generally permissible for an LLC. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a registered physical address within Egypt, evidenced by a lease-free/owned premises document or an authorized administrative office arrangement. Virtual mailbox services without a substantive physical address are not accepted; however, serviced desks with fixed Cairo location, physical signage, and mail-handling facilities may satisfy the threshold.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-low probability of approximately 20-30% in the first fiscal year; unannounced location visits may occur as part of GAFI inspection campaigns, Commercial Registry verification, or Tax Authority audit procedures, particularly to validate substance for VAT and Corporation Tax registration.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018 and Law No. 194 of 2020), Articles 1 and 20-39 (Limited Liability Company provisions), Executive Regulations Decree No. 96 of 1982 (as amended), Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, and the Civil Code provisions applicable to contracts.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop, Commercial Registry Department, Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Deed and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Taasis and Al-Nizam Al-Asasi) executed before a licensed Notary Public, registered with GAFI and entered in the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Executive Regulations of Law No. 159 of 1981 set the LLC minimum share capital at EGP 50,000 (approximately USD 1,000); the entire subscribed capital must be fully paid up at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a temporary escrow account opened in the company's name at a Central Bank of Egypt-licensed bank, and the bank's capital-deposit certificate is a mandatory GAFI filing. In-kind contributions must be valued by a licensed accountant or auditor through a notarized valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDERS' MEETING, ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY IN CAIRO: IT IS RESOLVED that the incorporation deed and Articles of Association of [LLC NAME] are hereby approved and adopted; every Founder irrevocably subscribes to the fully paid quotas shown opposite his name, evidenced by the bank certificate of deposit. IT IS FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office is fixed at [Registered Address, Cairo, Arab Republic of Egypt] and all statutory filings, including the Commercial Registry application, shall be submitted to GAFI. IT IS FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed sole Manager and Legal Representative with full banking, contracting, and employment authority for a five-year term; the secretary is instructed to effect all official registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation of Company Trade Name and Legal Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Invest in Egypt investor portal (investinegypt.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the single investor window, complete the company name request form with three Arabic name alternatives, pay the non-refundable name reservation fee online, and obtain the GAFI name-clearance certificate. The Arabic name must include the legal form 'LLC' and must not duplicate or conflict with an existing registered trade name or trademark.
required_dossiers: Completed GAFI name reservation application
Copy of each founder's national ID or passport
Signed declaration of non-conflicting trademark use
Proof of online fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, submit a written objection to GAFI's Legal Directorate within fifteen days or immediately resubmit with alternative names; no re-payment is required for one revision round.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Incorporation Deed and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office of the Ministry of Justice (Office of Authenticity, Cairo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the fully prepared Arabic incorporation deed and Articles of Association before the notary; each founder or authorized attorney-in-fact must appear in person, verify identity, and sign the deed in the notary's presence. A foreign founder must hold a certified power of attorney (attested by the Egyptian consulate) appointing a local representative. The notary records the deed and returns certified copies for GAFI filing.
required_dossiers: Arabic draft of the incorporation deed and Articles of Association
Founder national IDs or passports
GAFI name-clearance certificate
Certified power of attorney for any non-resident founder
Bank receipt of notarization fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the notary raises formal defects, sign a supplemental correction document to the deed; if a founder is absent, re-execute the signature after re-notarizing the power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital in Temporary Corporate Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the intended company name and deposit the fully subscribed share capital in cash, or present a bank transfer instruction from the founders' accounts. The bank performs mandatory AML/KYC due diligence on the beneficial owners and issues a capital-deposit certificate for submission to GAFI. The account is blocked until the company obtains its Commercial Registry certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation deed and Articles of Association
Founders' passport or ID and proof of address
AML/KYC declarations and source-of-funds statements
Beneficial ownership disclosure form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the transaction under AML rules, provide documented source of wealth and updated KYC; alternatively open the escrow account at a second bank and produce a revised deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Registration and Issuance of Commercial Registry Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Commercial Registry Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete statutory filing through the one-stop shop: incorporation deed, Articles of Association, bank capital-deposit certificate, name-clearance certificate, and appointment instruments. GAFI examines the file for legal compliance, levies the statutory fees, enters the company in the Commercial Registry, and issues the company seal authorization together with the commercial registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation deed and Articles of Association
Capital-deposit certificate issued by the bank
GAFI name-clearance certificate
Manager's acceptance-of-appointment declaration
Registered office lease contract
Payment receipt of incorporation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: When GAFI issues a query, respond in writing within fifteen days with supplementary evidence; any required amendment to the deed is executed as a notarized supplementary act and re-filed through the same one-stop shop window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Social Insurance, and Statistical Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - centralized GAFI windows
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Leverage the GAFI post-incorporation window to register the company for the electronic tax card (unified Tax Identification Number), value-added tax, and payroll taxes; simultaneously file NOSI declarations and statutory statistical registration with the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS). All forms are submitted in Arabic with the Commercial Registry certificate attached.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry certificate
Rent contract and landlord title deed
Manager appointment resolution and manager's national ID or passport
Bank account statement and company seal specimen
CAPMAS form (1) and NOSI declaration form 1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA or NOSI requests clarifications, respond within ten working days and republish the documents; disputes on registration fees are appealed to the Internal Taxes Committee and the Social Insurance Appeals Board respectively.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Final Post-Incorporation Actions: Seal, Permanent Bank Account, and Registered Office Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry and the designated commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Commercial Registry certificate is delivered, the manager obtains the company seal from a licensed engraver, converts the temporary escrow account into a permanent corporate account, and files the registered office lease and civil-defense clearance with the local administrative authority. The company then publishes the incorporation summary in the Commercial Registry gazette to complete the public-notice requirement.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry certificate
Tax card and NOSI registration certificate
Company seal authorization from GAFI
Board or manager resolution authorizing the permanent account
Certified copy of the registered office lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality objects to the registered office zoning, relocate the registered office within thirty days and file a change-of-address notification at the Commercial Registry; banking objections are cured by submitting the updated corporate documents.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) of the Ministry of Trade and Industry - industrial operating license regime; not triggered for pure e-commerce retail and warehousing of musical instruments.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Registration Certificate (trade license) issued under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; industrial operating license (Al-Torkhees Al-Sina'i) is not required for a retail and warehouse-only musical instruments business.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category C) - no manufacturing process, no significant resource consumption, and no hazardous emissions; only municipal registration of the office and warehouse premises is required under Environment Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Retail and warehousing operation generates no industrial wastewater discharge. Acoustic testing rooms must maintain boundary noise levels at or below 65 dB(A) pursuant to Environment Law No. 4 of 1994. End-of-life audio equipment, batteries, and packaging are classified as municipal and electronic waste, must be segregated at source, and transferred exclusively to EEAA-licensed recyclers under Law No. 202 of 2020. Incineration of any packaging or e-waste on the premises is prohibited. Storage aisles must allow adequate ventilation, and absorbent spill kits must be maintained for any incidental battery acid leakage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior) fire safety certificate for the office, showroom, and warehouse, including smoke detectors, marked exits, and Class-C dry chemical extinguishers; municipal structural safety inspection verifying floor load capacity for audio equipment pallet storage; and Ministry of Manpower occupational safety and health clearance compliant with Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, including first-aid kit, hazard signage, and manual-handling training for warehouse staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; e-invoicing portal: https://einvoice-tax.gov.eg; consolidated tax services portal: https://portal.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-established limited liability company must first obtain legal existence documentation from the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), then apply to the ETA for income tax registration (Tax Card) and VAT registration. If the foreign entity does not have an Egyptian branch registration, it must appoint an Egyptian tax agent or legal representative. Tax registration must be completed before supplies commence and within 30 days of the effective date of commercial activity; VAT registration is mandatory once annual taxable turnover exceeds EGP 500,000. Applications are filed through the ETA unified portal with the incorporation certificate, notarized and legalized power of attorney, passport/ID of the authorized signatory, proof of the Egyptian place of business, and projected turnover. Upon approval, the ETA issues a Tax Card number and VAT identification number; a separate onboarding request must be submitted for the ETA e-invoicing platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through entity classification election exists under Egyptian tax law. An Egyptian LLC is automatically a resident juridical person taxable at entity level on worldwide income under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. There is no hybrid-mismatch election; Egyptian domestic law does not incorporate an OECD hybrid-mismatch regime. The only relevant optional election is voluntary VAT registration before reaching the compulsory EGP 500,000 threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory registration); optional VAT registration is available below the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The ETA operates a mandatory electronic invoicing and electronic receipts regime under phased integration. VAT-registered taxpayers in mandatory phases must transmit B2B and B2C invoices, debit notes, and credit notes to the ETA e-invoicing portal in real time via API or the portal interface, using XML/JSON formats. Each accepted invoice is returned with a unique electronic tax code, cryptographic hash, QR code, and system validation status; invoices not cleared through the ETA platform are treated as not issued for VAT purposes. The system is clearance-based with centralized validation and registration, not a pre-approval stamping model. Taxpayers must integrate through an account-based API or file-based connection; failure to integrate or to invoice through the platform attracts penalties under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and the e-invoicing regulations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under Article 7 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 applies to exported goods and to services supplied to non-residents, provided the VAT-registered exporter proves that goods have physically departed Egypt and that the services are performed for a recipient outside Egypt. The exporter must maintain the export declaration, customs sign-out evidence, transport document, sales contract, and bank documentation. Missing an end-to-end documentation chain prevents zero-rating; input VAT attributable to non-export domestic supplies remains non-recoverable. Direct exports and deemed exports to free zones or economic zones may also qualify when the statutory free-zone procedures are observed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Final customs export declaration (Nafeza/ACI platform printout with customs approval and export stamp)
Bill of lading, multimodal transport document, or air waybill showing the Egyptian port/airport of exit and foreign destination
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
VAT sales invoice and e-invoice portal validation result showing zero-rated code
Bank foreign exchange receipt / Central Bank of Egypt inward remittance certificate confirming collection of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may verify export zero-rating relief retrospectively for five years from the month following the VAT return period. Refunds already released for fraudulent zero-rating claims are clawed back with penalties calculated under Law No. 67 of 2016. Tax evasion penalties range from substantial fines to imprisonment for responsible officers; understatement of VAT output or false export documentation also triggers customs penalties and loss of export privileges. Failure to comply with Central Bank of Egypt export-proceeds repatriation requirements may lead to restrictions on banking facilities, non-registration of future export declarations, and administrative monetary sanctions, in addition to VAT and customs assessments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - the sole monetary and foreign-exchange control authority; enforces exchange policy jointly with GAFI (General Authority for Investment) for foreign-investment registration and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) for profit-repatriation tax clearance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed-flexible interbank FX market (unified since March 2024); there is no fixed official rate. Current-account convertibility is liberal: trade-related payments are processed on documentary evidence (CargoX/NAFEZA ACI import declarations, proforma invoices, customs releases). Capital-account convertibility is conditional: foreign equity injections are permitted for GAFI-registered LLCs without prior CBE license, but every transaction must be routed through a CBE-licensed bank and reported on CBE Form 54 to enable future repatriation. Profit-remittance hurdles include: (i) an ETA tax-clearance certificate confirming no outstanding tax liabilities; (ii) audited financial statements; (iii) a valid management resolution declaring the dividend; (iv) payment of the 10% dividend withholding tax (treaty reduction typically 5-10%); and (v) a bank FX request form evidencing the underlying distribution. Egyptian LLCs may hold USD/EUR accounts to retain export proceeds; conversion to EGP is at the prevailing interbank rate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under current CBE unified instructions, proceeds from the export of goods (including online retail of musical instruments and audio gear) must be fully repatriated into a CBE-licensed bank account in Egypt within a statutory maximum of 120 days from the shipment date (bill-of-lading or airway-bill date). The export declaration must be lodged with the settlement bank before dispatch. As of the March 2024 float there is no mandatory ratio of conversion into EGP; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in a foreign-currency account and convert at interbank market rates as needed. Late or non-repatriation exposes the LLC to CBE sanctions, suspension of FX facilities, and referral to the AML/CFT supervisory framework.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account; temporary under-incorporation capital-verification account converts to operational upon GAFI/commercial-registry registration
Operational EGP Current Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account; temporary under-incorporation capital-verification account converts to operational upon registration
Operational EGP Current Account + USD/EUR Foreign-Currency Accounts; advanced digital trade-finance and FX platforms
Operational EGP Account + Multi-Currency FCY Account package; integrated with the HSBC global network for cross-border clearing
Operational EGP Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account
Operational EGP Account + USD Foreign-Currency Account; competitive treasury services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: LOW for offshore digital EMIs. CBE capital controls require all trade settlement and FX conversion for Egyptian resident entities to flow through CBE-licensed banks; offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, and similar non-Egyptian digital account providers) cannot lawfully clear this LLC's export proceeds, and Egyptian banks will reject payments routed through them. Regarding the target payment rails: PayPal Egypt is a CBE-supervised receive/withdrawal channel - the LLC may accept e-commerce receipts and withdraw in EGP to an Egyptian bank account, but cannot retain USD balances; Stripe does not issue merchant accounts to Egyptian-incorporated entities. The recommended architecture is Stripe/PayPal as customer-facing front ends feeding a CBE-licensed local aggregator (Paymob, Fawry, or e-finance) or an overseas sales subsidiary, with final settlement into the Egyptian treasury accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is MANDATORY for at least one authorized signatory (LLC manager/managing director) and for any natural-person shareholder or UBO holding more than 25%. CBE AML/CFT rules (AML Law 80/2002 and CBE KYC circulars) require an in-branch identification and compliance interview; remote/video onboarding for new Egyptian corporate accounts is not accepted by major banks. Non-resident managers may delegate authority through a notarized Power of Attorney legalized by the Egyptian consulate in the jurisdiction of signing; the resident attorney must appear in person with the original POA, certified passport copies, and a banker's reference from the foreign remitting bank. E-signature tools (Law 15/2004) may be used post-onboarding for routine instructions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border e-commerce inflows from marketplace/PSP aggregators (Stripe, PayPal, Shopify) with low average ticket values and no physical point of sale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Marketplace seller agreement; 90-day platform settlement statements; order-level sales ledger mapped to NAFEZA/CargoX ACI export declarations; sampled ETA e-invoice copies from the EBIS portal; published returns/refund policy; warehouse and logistics documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders owning more than 25% (foreign ownership permitted) triggering enhanced UBO due diligence and source-of-wealth review
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI incorporation certificate evidencing foreign participation; UBO declaration on the standard CBE AML form; notarized and apostilled/consulate-legalized passport copies; banker's reference from each UBO's home bank; audited personal financial statements or lawful-source-of-funds evidence (salary slips, dividend vouchers, asset sale contracts).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection coded as 'investment' without supporting corporate documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement; management resolution of the LLC authorizing the capital increase and naming bank signatories; GAFI foreign-investment registration certificate; Memorandum and Articles of Association as reviewed by bank counsel; SWIFT MT103 with purpose field clearly stating 'Equity Contribution - Capital Increase' and referencing the GAFI registration number.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Tax Form No. 4)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year-end; for a calendar tax year, by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 2% per month on unpaid tax; late-filing fine of up to EGP 50,000 plus 20% of the tax due for wilful non-filing; continued non-compliance may trigger tax collection enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Commercial Registry Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end and after approval by the shareholders' general assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for late filing and risk of regulatory strike-off by GAFI for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal required annually before 31 March; tax card remains tied to the active commercial registration record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal results in inability to tender for contracts, customs clearance blocks, and additional late renewal fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due by 31 March; any share transfer or UBO change must be filed within 30 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 100,000 per violation and possible suspension of corporate filings for non-compliant companies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All limited liability companies registered in Egypt must appoint at least one certified auditor admitted to the GAFI auditors' registry; there is no revenue or asset exemption for the statutory audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Financial Reporting Standards (EFRS), substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), as issued by the Ministry of Finance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain an accurate register of beneficial owners at its registered office and file any shareholding transfer or UBO change with GAFI within 30 days. An annual confirmation attesting to the accuracy of the UBO register must be filed with GAFI by 31 March each year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Flat 22.5% statutory CIT for a standard LLC with no general permanent exemption; targeted incentives only under Investment Law No. 72/2017 (30% deduction of qualifying fixed investment costs and 50% taxable-base reduction for projects in Zone C governorates) and free-zone/SCZone regimes (fee of up to 1% of value added in lieu of CIT); tax losses carried forward for five years, no carryback.
